_meta.description: Golden Q&A pairs for the Atlas CI eval suite, drafted against docs/FACTS.md.
_meta.note: expect_refusal=true items are Deliberate Gaps (docs/FACTS.md Deliberate Gaps section) — a correct system must decline to answer, not invent a figure.
_meta.scope: This file covers Normal Requests + Missing Data only — the two categories meaningful at v0.1 (baseline). Edge Cases (empty/multilingual/cross-source/long queries) land at v0.3 once hybrid retrieval exists to stress; Adversarial Prompts (15+ injection techniques) land at v0.5 once the guardrail layer exists to test. See docs/specs/EVOLUTION.md.
_meta.fixtures: Every question is answerable from eval/fixtures/{emails,notion_pages,drive_docs}.json — a 48-document curated subset (23 Gmail + 11 Notion + 14 Drive) built by scripts/build_fixtures.py from data/corpus. This is CI's index, not the full 256-document corpus. Roughly half the documents are never a correct source for any question; they are near-neighbour distractors drawn from the dense neighbourhoods in docs/PERSONA.md (financials, compensation, renewals, SSO/identity, roadmap). They are what make Context Precision and reranking measurable. There is deliberately no per-document relevance tag: relevance is a property of the (question, document) pair, defined only by the per-question source fields below.
_meta.source_semantics: acceptable_sources: documents that supply a necessary part of the expected answer — for multi_hop questions the set is needed jointly; otherwise each listed document is individually sufficient. partial_sources: documents that corroborate a fragment of the answer but cannot support it alone — retrieving one is not a recall success and must not be scored as a precision failure. expect_refusal questions list no sources: the answer exists nowhere in the fixtures.

questions.question: What date did Tensile promise Northwind Logistics that SAML SSO would ship?
questions.expected_answer: 15 September 2026. The commitment was made on 11 June 2026 and was timed to put Northwind two weeks clear of their access audit and ahead of the 30 September renewal.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Northwind Thread, 'The commitment' table

questions.question: Who made the SSO promise to Northwind, and who else saw it?
questions.expected_answer: Marcus Oyelaran (Head of Sales) promised it to Linda Marsh in an email dated 11 June 2026. Ravi Menon (CEO) was CC'd on the thread.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Northwind Thread, 'The commitment' table

questions.question: Did we commit SAML SSO to Northwind, and is it actually on the product roadmap in time for their renewal?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, SSO was promised for 15 September 2026, but it is not a Q3 deliverable. The Q3 roadmap (Jul–Sep) ships distributed tracing GA, self-serve onboarding, billing revamp, and audit log export, and lists 'SAML SSO / enterprise identity' under Deferred to Q4 — the stated reason being that tracing GA and billing consume the quarter and identity is a multi-week build with an auth-path migration. SSO is scheduled Oct–Nov 2026 on the Q4 roadmap, which is after both the promised date and Northwind's 30 September 2026 renewal.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Northwind Thread, 'The reality' table
questions.trap: SSO fact split across Gmail (promise) and Notion (roadmap) — flagship demo question, no single source answers it

questions.question: Does the customer commitments log in Notion record the SSO promise made to Northwind?
questions.expected_answer: No. The Notion customer commitments log records commitments to Northwind (audit logs, Q3), Bastion Freight (SOC 2 report), and Calder Systems (SLA upgrade), but it does not record the SSO promise. That promise exists only in the Gmail thread.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Northwind Thread, 'The third surface'

questions.question: When is Northwind Logistics' contract up for renewal?
questions.expected_answer: 30 September 2026. The MSA was executed on 30 September 2025 with an initial twelve-month term, at an annual fee of $84,000 for 40 named users.

questions.question: How many named users does Northwind have now, versus at signature?
questions.expected_answer: 40 users at signature, grown to 58 active users since then.
questions.note: gmail-northwind-renewal answers both halves in one sentence ('you've gone from 40 to 58 active users since signature'). The MSA is partial only: clause 3.2 covers 'up to forty (40) Named Users' but has no current count.

questions.question: What was Tensile's ARR in June 2026?
questions.expected_answer: $940,000 — up 9.3% month over month, a deceleration from prior months, on June MRR of $78,300.
questions.trap: One of six near-identical monthly investor updates — tests whether retrieval finds the correct month, not just 'an' update

questions.question: What was Tensile's ARR in July 2026?
questions.expected_answer: $1,040,000 — up 10.6% month over month, crossing the $1M mark, on July MRR of $86,700.
questions.trap: Same as q07 — near-duplicate monthly updates

questions.question: How much did month-over-month growth decelerate in June 2026, and by how much?
questions.expected_answer: Growth decelerated to 9.3% month-over-month in June, down from roughly 11.5% the prior trend.
questions.source: FACTS.md — Financials by Month, note below table

questions.question: What is Tensile's current cash runway as of August 2026?
questions.expected_answer: Roughly 7 months — cash runs out at approximately March 2027 at current burn, absent the Series A.
questions.source: FACTS.md — Financials by Month, runway note
questions.note: Partly computational: 'March 2027' is stated verbatim in the financial model, but the '7 months' figure is not — it must be derived from August cash ($1,334,000) divided by August net burn ($192,000) = 6.9 months. Grade the March 2027 date as the retrievable fact; treat the month count as derived.

questions.question: What terms did Fernpath Capital offer in their term sheet?
questions.expected_answer: $12M at a $52M post-money valuation, 1x non-participating preference, broad-based weighted average anti-dilution, option pool negotiated down to 10.5% pre-money. One board seat to Fernpath (board goes to five), with an independent seat to be filled within six months of close.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Raise, Fernpath Capital table
questions.trap: Distinctive proper noun 'Fernpath' — exact match vs paraphrase test

questions.question: What has Aster Ventures indicated for the Series A, and do they have a term sheet?
questions.expected_answer: Aster (partner James Okonkwo) has indicated $10M at a $45M post-money valuation, but has only verbal interest — no term sheet has been issued.
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Raise, Aster Ventures table
questions.note: drive-pitch-deck-v3 shows the same $10M-at-$45M figures but as Tensile's own ask, never attributed to Aster — citing it for Aster's indication would be wrong, so it is deliberately not a source.

questions.question: When does Fernpath's exclusivity period expire?
questions.expected_answer: 21 August 2026 (30 days from the term sheet received on 22 July 2026).
questions.source: FACTS.md — The Raise, Fernpath Capital table
questions.note: Partial: Ravi tells James the term sheet 'carries thirty days of exclusivity' but never states the 21 August expiry date.

questions.question: Between pitch deck v3 and v4, which one shows a $12M ask and an enterprise slide?
questions.expected_answer: Pitch deck v4, dated 17 July 2026, shows the $12M at $52M ask and includes the enterprise slide. v3 (6 July 2026) shows ARR of $940,000 and a $10M at $45M ask, with no enterprise slide.
questions.source: FACTS.md — Pitch Decks, the near-miss pair
questions.trap: Near-identical documents, different figures — cleanest reranking test in the corpus

questions.question: What base salary is Elena Vasquez asking for, and how does it compare to the approved budget?
questions.expected_answer: Elena is asking $265,000 base, which is $25,000 over the approved $240,000 budget. She is also above the approved 0.8% equity band, asking 0.9%.
questions.note: Partials each state the approved band ($240,000 / 0.8%) and the board-approval rule but not Elena's ask — that lives only in her comp email and the hiring pipeline.

questions.question: How does Tom Brennan's ask compare to the approved Head of Engineering budget?
questions.expected_answer: Tom is asking $225,000 base and 0.6% equity, both under the approved budget of $240,000 base and 0.8% equity.
questions.note: Partials each state the approved band but not Tom's ask — that lives only in his comp email and the hiring pipeline.

questions.question: What is the notice period difference between the two Head of Engineering candidates?
questions.expected_answer: Elena Vasquez has an 8-week notice period; Tom Brennan has a 4-week notice period.

questions.question: What is the decision deadline for the Head of Engineering role?
questions.expected_answer: 22 August 2026. The role is at final stage with two candidates, Elena Vasquez and Tom Brennan.

questions.question: How much of Tensile's current ARR is at risk from unmet enterprise requirements, and which accounts?
questions.expected_answer: $190,000, or 22% of current ARR, across three accounts: Northwind Logistics ($84,000, needs SAML SSO and audit log export, renews 30 Sep 2026), Calder Systems ($62,000, needs SOC 2 Type II, renews 1 Jan 2027), and Bastion Freight ($48,000, needs SOC 2 Type II, renews 1 Mar 2027).
questions.note: Partials corroborate single rows of the risk table (Calder's SOC 2 need and January renewal; Bastion's blocked expansion; Northwind's flagged requirements) but none contains the $190,000 / 22% aggregate.

questions.question: Which of the at-risk accounts renews before its required capability is expected to ship?
questions.expected_answer: Northwind Logistics is the only one falling due (30 Sep 2026) before its required capability (SSO) is expected to land (Oct–Nov 2026).
questions.source: FACTS.md — Customers, note below 'ARR at risk' table

questions.question: What is the procurement deadline Northwind gave for the renewal decision?
questions.expected_answer: 5 September 2026. Linda Marsh set that as the deadline for the renewal paperwork, and requires written confirmation of the 15 September SSO date before taking it to procurement.

questions.question: What renewal price did Tensile propose to Northwind, and how did Linda Marsh respond?
questions.expected_answer: Tensile proposed $96,000 (a 14% uplift from $84,000), offered on 3 August 2026. Linda Marsh declined, pending confirmation that SSO would ship.
questions.note: drive-financial-model-2026 was removed as a source after close-reading: it contains no $96,000 figure (an earlier regex matched the substring inside September's $196,000 forecast burn) and nothing about Linda's response.

questions.question: What is Bastion Freight waiting on before it will convert or expand?
questions.expected_answer: Bastion Freight is waiting on Tensile's SOC 2 report. Owen Fitzgerald, their CTO, cannot put an expansion through procurement without it, and wants to extend Tensile to two further engineering groups.

questions.question: Who filled the independent board seat at Tensile?
questions.expected_answer: This information is not available in the corpus. As of the current data, the independent board seat is vacant and no filling decision has been recorded.

questions.question: What did Northwind Logistics decide about their renewal?
questions.expected_answer: This information is not available in the corpus — Northwind's renewal decision is not recorded anywhere in the dataset.

questions.question: Which candidate, Elena Vasquez or Tom Brennan, was hired as Head of Engineering?
questions.expected_answer: This information is not available in the corpus — no hiring decision is recorded for the Head of Engineering role.

questions.question: Did the Fernpath Series A round close?
questions.expected_answer: The outcome is not recorded in the corpus. The latest data (August 2026) shows the round still in progress: term sheet signed 22 July, diligence underway, close targeted by 31 October per the Q3 OKRs ('Round closed and funded — Not started'). Whether it ultimately closed is unknown and must not be asserted either way.
questions.note: Grading: a grounded 'not closed as of the latest data, outcome unknown' is correct; a bare refusal is also acceptable. Asserting that the round closed or failed is the failure this question exists to catch. notion-okrs-q3-2026 legitimately supports the in-progress framing without answering the outcome.

questions.expected_answer: This information is not available in the corpus — no revenue figures are recorded after August 2026.
